title: The Interior of the fourth floor walk-up
author: Ulyana Brightwater
blurb: Astrid Okonkwo, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
